mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Identity of Ultimate Beneficial Owner

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against Egyptian PEP lists, UN sanctions lists, OFAC sanctions lists, EU sanctions lists, and domestic Egyptian sanctions and adverse media databases

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Egyptian Commercial Registry Portal (Ministry of Trade and Industry - Commercial Register Department)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Arabic script as primary language; English names permitted with Arabic transliteration. Names must comply with Arabic linguistic requirements and not be identical or similar to existing registered companies.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Words indicating banking, insurance, or financial services without prior ministerial approval
Names conflicting with public institutions or trademarks
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name reservation is rejected, file an administrative appeal to the Minister of Trade and Industry within 15 days, providing reasons, supporting documents, and any proposed corrections

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not accepted for industrial manufacturing activities; physical presence and economic substance are mandatory
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (unannounced inspections by tax authorities and Commercial Registry for manufacturing and industrial entities)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence, incorporation documents drafting, and cross-border compliance review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian counsel and international law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for pre-incorporation services in Egypt

Apostille authentication and document translation services
UBO beneficial ownership identification, verification, and sanctions screening

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for industrial entity setup

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018 and Executive Regulations, Book II: Limited Liability Companies, arts. 48-117); Trade Register Law No. 34 of 1976; Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), Commercial Registration Department, Cairo One-Stop Shop.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum of Association executed before an Egyptian Notary Public and registered with GAFI and the Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs; founders freely set capital in the Memorandum of Association. Cash contributions require a temporary escrow deposit in an Egyptian bank before incorporation, with the deposit certificate filed with GAFI and released to the company upon issuance of the incorporation certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the company be and is hereby incorporated as an Egyptian limited liability company under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended. RESOLVED, that the founders' share subscription list, including valuation of in-kind contributions by a licensed valuer, be approved. RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at the industrial facility, Suez Canal Economic Zone, and that the Articles of Association govern the company. RESOLVED, that [Name] be appointed General Manager and legal representative, and [Name] Chief Financial Officer, each authorized to execute the incorporation filings and maintain corporate records until the first General Assembly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed trade names in the prescribed form; GAFI conducts automated conflict and compliance screening against the Commercial Registry database; upon approval, a name reservation certificate valid for 90 days is issued.
required_dossiers: Copy of authorized representative's national ID or passport
Power of attorney if filed through a corporate services agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity, file a corrective application with alternative names against the preliminary refusal decision; escalation to the GAFI Registration Committee is available through the ombudsman window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Memorandum of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association in Arabic or bilingual format, execute signatures of all founding partners or their attorneys, and certify the instrument before the competent Notary Public; verification of capacity and authentication of signatures is performed.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
Notarized powers of attorney for signatories
Proof of in-kind contribution appraisal report, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary issues an objection on draft clauses, prepare a supplementary amendment deed and re-present the instrument; rejections are cured by revising contested provisions to comply with Law 159/1981.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Temporary Capital Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian bank branch (e.g., National Bank of Egypt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a special escrow account under the proposed company name; deposit the cash capital subscribed by the founders; obtain an official bank deposit certificate evidencing the paid-in amount and account details for the GAFI submission.
required_dossiers: Tax identification numbers of foreign founders if registered in Egypt
Bank account opening application and AML/KYC declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses opening due to AML documentation gaps, supplement with source-of-funds declarations and notarized KYC forms; GAFI may issue a letter requesting bank facilitation where escrow regulations are misapplied.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Application and Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (Cairo and Suez Canal Economic Zone branch)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation dossier electronically and physically with GAFI; GAFI reviews legal compliance, notarization validity, and capital escrow certification; upon approval, GAFI issues the company incorporation certificate and registers the entity in its national database.
required_dossiers: Bank deposit certificate for cash contributions
Lease or title deed of the registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI requests clarifications, file a formal response within 14 days; remedy omissions through the One-Stop Shop resolution desk; prolonged non-response may be escalated to the GAFI Legal Affairs Department for deemed approval review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry, Commercial Registry Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the newly incorporated LLC in the Commercial Registry by submitting incorporation certificates and authorized signatory details; obtain the commercial registration certificate evidencing legal personality and trade capacity.
required_dossiers: Copy of the General Manager's identity document
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry imposes a restrictive classification, file an administrative appeal with the Registry Supervisor; erroneous entries are corrected by a written rectification request and supporting incorporation documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Tax Card Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Corporate Taxpayer Registration Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the unified tax card for corporate income tax, and register for VAT where applicable; ETA issues the tax card after verifying incorporation documents and economic activity codes under ISIC 2620.
required_dossiers: Tax registration forms (Form T1, VAT form)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ETA delays or queries the economic activity code, resubmit with ISIC 2620 classification rationale and evidence of production capability; tax card issuance may be expedited through the ETA investor liaison unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial Premises Registration and Work Commencement Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) and SCZone Authority for factories within the Economic Zone
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File notification of the actual factory premises with IDA under the Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017; submit site layout and production process description for provisional operational clearance while awaiting the full industrial operating license.
required_dossiers: Site technical drawings and edge computing assembly line plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If IDA requests supplementary environmental or structural documentation, submit to the IDA licensing committee; provisional clearance is renewable while environmental review procedures complete.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA), under Law No. 15 of 2017 regulating industrial facilities licensing
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License for Electronic Manufacturing (Rugged Computers and Edge Gateways), ISIC 2620

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B — Simplified Environmental Impact Assessment Report (annual compliance screening, as electronic assembly activities are not low-impact but present manageable wastewater and solder fume risks)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges to public sewer must comply with Law 93/62 limits and Decree 44/2000 endpoints (pH 6.5-9, COD ≤ 600 mg/L, BOD ≤ 300 mg/L, TSS ≤ 350 mg/L, heavy metals below tolerance); VOC-containing solder fume emissions must remain within Cabinet Decree 338/1995 ambient air limits of 0.15 mg/m³ lead particulate and 10 mg/m³ total volatile organics in the workplace stack; hazardous electronic waste, including lead-bearing boards and cooling fluids, must be segregated and transferred to EEAA-licensed recyclers under waste manifests prescribed by Law 202/2020.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety System Certification from the General Directorate of Civil Defense under Law No. 93 of 1996, including fire suppression zoning for lithium battery testing areas; structural load inspection certificates; occupational health clearance from the Ministry of Manpower verifying workstation ergonomics, respirator programs for soldering stations, and emergency evacuation drills.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance, Arab Republic of Egypt; e-services portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned EG LLC first obtains commercial registration with the General Authority for Investment (GAFI), then registers with the Egyptian Tax Authority district office to receive a Tax Card/TIN and, once taxable supplies meet the threshold, a VAT registration certificate. Non-resident suppliers without an Egyptian establishment must appoint an Egyptian tax representative and file the ETA VAT registration application with Arabic-notarised constitutional documents and a power of attorney.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election regime exists in Egypt; LLCs are statutorily treated as Egyptian tax-resident corporations taxed on worldwide income, and no elective pass-through classification is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual value of taxable supplies and imports (VAT Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All registered businesses subject to Egypt's e-invoicing mandate must transmit invoices to the ETA-integrated fiscal clearance system in real time in XML/JSON format via the ETA IDC APIs. Each invoice receives an electronic reference code and QR code before delivery; failure to submit or obtain clearance can trigger fines and disallowed input VAT recovery.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Tangible goods qualify for 0% VAT when physically exported from Egypt under a valid customs export declaration and when title and risk have passed to a foreign buyer. Zero rating also applies to qualifying exported/offshore services actually consumed outside Egypt and to international transport services; evidence of export delivery and repatriation of sale proceeds in freely convertible currency is required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA may audit export transactions for up to five years; a false or failed export zero-rating claim triggers immediate assessment of VAT at 14% plus late interest, a penalty between 30% and 100% of the tax evaded, forfeiture of input VAT credits, clawback of refunds, and criminal liability for fraud when documents are falsified.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE); legal bases: Foreign Exchange Law No. 80 of 1947, Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law), CBE Board Decision No. 234 of 2011 (repatriation of export proceeds) as amended, and the CBE directives of 6 March 2024 establishing a unified free-float interbank foreign-exchange market.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt has accepted IMF Article VIII, so current-account transactions are freely convertible under a documented underlying; since 6 March 2024 the Egyptian pound trades unified under a market-clearing float with no CBE restrictions on legitimate trade settlements, dividend or profit remittances routed through an authorized bank. Capital-account items are only partially liberalized: inward FDI equity is permitted under GAFI Law No. 72 of 2017 subject to positive-list screening and initial deposit verification; portfolio flows, shareholder loans, hedging positions and change-of-control disposals require separate CBE registration. Profit remittance hurdles are largely documentary: audited annual financial statements, Egyptian corporate tax returns and tax clearance certificate, settlement of applicable Egyptian withholding obligations on profit distribution, and funding of the remitting foreign-currency account exclusively with realized export proceeds or registered capital; operational hurdles are EGP liquidity constraints and bank-level documentation queues.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender ratio applies after the 6 March 2024 liberalization: the industrial exporter may retain 100% of USD/EUR export receipts in a dedicated exporters' foreign-currency account and may use them for trade settlements, permitted hedging or voluntary sale to the bank at interbank rates. Statutory repatriation timeline: proceeds of each shipment must be remitted into Egypt within 90 days from the bill of lading/airway bill date (or the underlying letter-of-credit maturity), and a formal bank-approved extension up to 180 days is available for trade-finance-backed structures. The duty bank must report overdue cases to the CBE compliance unit, exposing the exporter to administrative fines, reduction of authorized-dealer limits and denial of future approval before a breach is cured.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital-subscription escrow (company-in-formation) account; operational EGP/USD current account; USD export-proceeds concentration account
Operational EGP current account; USD commercial letter-of-credit and import settlements; export proceeds account
Multi-currency treasury current account (EGP/USD/EUR); corporate FX forward and swap line; trade-finance account
Corporate EGP/USD settlement account; GCC-remittance oriented collections
Export-proceeds USD account; pre-shipment and export LC discounting facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium (narrow perimeter). Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Revolut-type platforms) are not licensed Egyptian payment institutions under CBE E-Money regulations and Law No. 18 of 2019 (non-cash payments); they cannot serve as the treasury-of-record or receive EGP settlement for tax purposes. They may be used only as auxiliary outbound rails for low-value B2B supplier disbursements, software licensing and expatriate contractor payments, subject to (i) a signed contract identifying the EMI counterparty, (ii) a monthly sweep cap of 15% of operational disbursements, and (iii) an accounting policy treating EMI balances as foreign bank accounts attracting CBE reporting and Egyptian GAAP/TFRS note disclosure; inbound flows from EMIs to the Egyptian operating bank must always be supported by the underlying invoice, otherwise they are treated as unverified third-party credits and can be frozen under AML protocols.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory in the first cycle: at least one resident general manager or principal shareholder owning 25% or more must attend a personal compliance interview at the chosen branch, and an Arabic notarized power of attorney should be lodged in favor of an Egyptian comptroller/attorney for ongoing operations. CBE's digital e-KYC framework permits remote onboarding for certain retail products, but for foreign-owned LLC corporate accounts the banks' standard practice is one initial in-person KYC interview with the authorized executive, after which digital signatures and SWIFT-based instructions are accepted; a purely remote opening without any physical appearance is unlikely for the ISIC 2620 manufacturing exporter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value initial USD capital injection from a non-resident technology parent ahead of GAFI registration.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized parent board resolution authorizing the contribution; certified copy of parent incorporation (apostille or consularized); parent audited financial statements for the last two years; originating bank statement; signed source-of-funds declaration; updated UBO chart; escrow letter from the receiving Egyptian bank evidencing reserved funds under Companies Law No. 4 of 2018.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Misalignment between the declared ISIC 2620 industrial activity and import documentation; dual-use or export-control screening of edge-computing components.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GOEIC import/export registration; importer's declaration Form 4 for each shipment; commodity classification sheets (HS 8471 / 8517); supplier end-use certificates; U.S. EAR and EU dual-use classification references; proforma invoices, purchase orders and technical datasheets confirming non-sensitive industrial grade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure or opaque offshore intermediate entity in the shareholder chain (BVI, Seychelles or similar), or PEP presence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening reports for all UBOs and counterparties; written negative-media and PEP check; commercial-substance proof of the intermediate holding company (registered office, staff, financial statements); shareholder register and the statutory beneficial-ownership filing to the Egyptian registry; legal opinion from Egyptian counsel confirming the chain is clean.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Detected crypto-asset, e-wallet or unstructured web-payment inflows during pre-account credit history review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-adopted treasury policy prohibiting crypto and third-party credits; complete customer contracts proving B2B invoice-backed flows; bank account opening questionnaire limiting rails to SWIFT/LC; AML officer memorandum stating the parent compliance review; projected monthly turnover vs invoice register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency outbound trade payments to multiple foreign suppliers triggering CBE trade-finance anomaly checks (invoice overpricing, split payments).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Four-corner trade file per payment: signed commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading/airway bill, GOEIC customs release, CBE FX ticket and MT103 confirmation; third-party price benchmark documentation from component market indices; proof of receipt of goods (delivery certificates); 90-day export proceeds reconciliation and auditor's confirmation of commercial reality.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: (i) open a temporary capital-subscription escrow account at a CBE-licensed bank (NBE, Banque Misr or CIB) after GAFI name reservation; (ii) remit the FDI equity via SWIFT MT103 from the parent's own corporate account in a single value transfer with the CBE statutory foreign-exchange ticket purpose code for 'direct investment in Egypt - equity capital' and reference text 'capital contribution to EG_LLC under Companies Law No. 4 of 2018'; (iii) deliver to the bank the parent board resolution, constitutional documents, audited statements, UBO declaration, apostilled passports and the signed escrow agreement; (iv) after Commercial Registry issuance, the bank releases the escrowed funds into EG_LLC's operational USD account and submits the statutory inward-investment verification to CBE; (v) where capital is denominated in EGP, the USD conversion ticket is issued at the interbank rate on-site and the MT103 remains part of the bank's verification file; (vi) do not split the injection into sub-threshold tranches and do not route through third-party FX brokers, both of which trigger automated CBE monitoring and can block further treasury operations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rails are: SWIFT MT103 for operating disbursements and freight/insurance/e-licensing payments, and irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit (SWIFT MT700) issued by the Egyptian bank and advised/confirmed by the supplier's bank for industrial component imports. Every outbound payment requires a CBE FX ticket matched to a signed underlying obligation, Egyptian tax card and, for physical goods, a GOEIC import declaration (Form 4) or customs release as attachment. Export proceeds must be earmarked forward: the USD export-proceeds account is the first source for outbound USD settlements, with any shortfall covered through the FX forward line; all rails must be cleared through CBE's interbank infrastructure rather than crypto networks or offshore E-money loops.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EGP/USD FX forward contract (tenor up to 12 months) with a CBE-licensed counterparty, executed against underlying trade invoices (permissible under the 2024 free-float framework).
FX swap (spot against forward) for short-term EGP/USD liquidity matching within the same booking bank.
USD/EGP cross-currency swap for matched debt-service hedging on registered shareholder loans, subject to CBE derivative exposure reporting.
European-style FX option (USD call / EGP put) evidenced by a genuine export sales receivable and approved by the treasury committee.

Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF): expressly not permissible onshore; CBE rules prohibit EGP NDF settlement within the Egyptian banking market, so EG_LLC must prohibit NDFs in its treasury policy statement and source all hedging from licensed Egyptian banks.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade / GAFI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days before each registration anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily late fine for delayed renewal; continued failure exposes LLC to administrative strike-off and loss of legal standing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before 1 January or on the expiry date shown on the tax card
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Increase of prior-year tax assessment and inability to execute trade with public sector; additional late renewal penalty imposed by ETA

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end; for calendar year entities by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed monthly late filing penalty plus 2% per month delay tax on assessed corporate income tax; risk of tax inspection and criminal action

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements and Auditor's Report Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) / Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of fiscal year-end and before the annual general assembly; calendar-year entities typically by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Refusal of commercial registry renewal and commercial registration suspension; directors may be held personally liable for concealment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) / Egyptian Money Laundering and Combating Terrorism Financing Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the time of the ordinary general assembly; UBO changes must be filed within 15 days of occurrence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EGP 100,000 for non-disclosure under AML Law 80/2002; criminal penalties for intentional false declarations

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every Egyptian LLC must appoint an auditor. Compulsory independent audit applies to LLCs with issued capital exceeding EGP 50,000 or annual turnover exceeding EGP 1,000,000; in practice the ETA requires audited financial statements attached to the corporate income tax return for all active LLCs
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), effective under Ministerial Decree No. 110/2015, substantially convergent with IFRS; IFRS as adopted by the Egyptian Financial Supervisory Authority is permitted for listed entities and consolidated financial statements

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain a UBO register and confirm its content annually at the ordinary general assembly; every share transfer, membership change, or change in beneficial control must be recorded in the register and reported to GAFI within 15 days of the triggering event

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500 – 4,500 for an industrial edge computing LLC with export operations

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (tax credit 30%-50% of investment cost; up to 5-year exemption for new companies in targeted sectors); reduced rates for manufacturing activities under Cabinet incentives; special economic zone (SCZONE) exemptions subject to approval.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Tax Return Form (Model 1) filed via Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal (www.etax.gov.eg)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (fiscal year); interim advance payments made quarterly or monthly as required by ETA
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the fiscal year-end; e.g., December year-end files by 30 April

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal entity identification and tax card number of the LLC
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter Egyptian Tax Identification Number (TIN); a non-resident owner may be required to obtain a temporary filing code for the local LLC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross industrial sales revenue from edge computing systems
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include Egypt-source income and export income attributed to the Egyptian LLC; align sales with transfer pricing margins.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold and direct industrial input costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support with customs declarations, vendor invoices and inventory logs; related-party imported components must be arm's length priced.
Reconcile with audited financial statements; foreign shareholders should document management fees as per transfer pricing rules.
Loss carryforward is permitted only if the same economic activity continues and no substantial shareholder change occurs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax due per month or part-month (capped at 50%) plus annual late-payment surcharge; additional administrative fines up to EGP 200,000 for systematic non-filing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Non-resident shareholder must lodge a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the residence state, submit it to the Egyptian domestic withholding agent, and file an Article 11 (or relevant DTA article) relief application with the Egyptian Tax Authority before or immediately after distribution to invoke reduced treaty withholding or exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: interest 10%, royalties 20%; treaty participation rates are commonly 5%-15% for interest and 5%-20% for royalties depending on the DTA effective date and reciprocity.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 1,000,000 (annual related-party transactions) for TP Information Return (Form TT1); Local File required where related-party transactions exceed EGP 15 million; Master File required for multinational enterprise groups with consolidated turnover above EGP 600 million.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not operate a stand-alone Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) regime; however, the general anti-avoidance rules under Law 91 of 2005 and the Agency and Investment Laws empower the tax administration to assess economic substance, disregard artificial or non-commercial transactions, and deny treaty/tax-incentive benefits where a mere shell arrangement is present.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of industrial sales invoices, false depreciation schedules, manipulated export documentation, or underreporting of profits derived from edge computing systems.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of 3 to 5 years and monetary penalty equal to the amount of evaded tax; tax authorities also impose double tax surcharge and bar the taxpayer from future tax settlements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil can be pierced where directors actively conceal transactions; directors jointly and severally liable for restitution of evaded tax plus civil penalties; criminal judges may impose travel bans and freeze personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating through a nominal Egyptian LLC with no physical office, no commercial staff, and central management and control outside Egypt solely to route industrial computing revenues through a no/favourable-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disallowance of all intercompany deductions, assessment of deemed dividends/royalty income subject to withholding tax, and administrative penalties reaching 20% of the attributed profit; the entity may be struck off in case of sham status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors are personally liable for fraudulent creditor and tax misrepresentation; courts may order tracing of assets, enforce civil restitution, and issue travel bans against foreign shareholders who control the shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting the proceeds of SWIFT / TT wire transfers in connection with Export of edge-computing systems from a sanctioned jurisdiction, or receiving unbacked physical currency transfers above the statutory threshold, without the required Customer Due Diligence and Suspicious Transaction Reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Anti-Money Laundering Law 80 of 2002 and Executive Regulations, fines up to EGP 5 million for unpermitted transfers, plus imprisonment of 3–7 years for laundering offences; confiscation of unlawful proceeds and freezing of corporate bank accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers with supervisory responsibility face criminal imprisonment and personal fines; non-executive shareholders can be joined under joint tortious liability if they deliberately exploit the corporate structure to launder illegal industrial proceeds.
